_meta.description: Deployment privacy policy for OptiRoute AI multi-objective routing. Administrators edit this file; the router reloads it at startup. Nothing here is a verified provider guarantee: retention/processing fields default to 'administrator-configured' unless the deployment has contractual evidence, and locally_hosted defaults are derived from models_registry.json notes ('originally self-hosted').

provenance.locally_hosted: models_registry.json notes: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B were originally self-hosted via local inference servers; all other entries point at public provider endpoints.
provenance.data_retention: NOT verified by this project. Left as 'administrator-configured' so no provider privacy guarantee is fabricated.
provenance.pricing_and_latency: Measured in routing/data/routing_matrix.csv (Phase-1 benchmark); not part of this file.

semantics.approved_for_sensitive: model may receive queries the sensitivity classifier marks sensitive
semantics.hard_constraint: The privacy filter runs BEFORE model selection: an ineligible model can never be selected, regardless of utility.

deployment.note: With allow_external_models=false the router behaves like private mode for every query. With allow_sensitive_queries=false, sensitive queries are refused instead of being routed to an approved model.

sensitivity.description: Deterministic LOCAL classifier: regex patterns + keywords evaluated on the query text inside this process. No query ever leaves the machine to be classified, and raw query text is not logged by the router.

Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.data_retention: none - inference runs on deployment hardware
Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.source: models_registry.json: 'Zero-cost anchor; originally self-hosted via local inference server'

Qwen3-8B.data_retention: none - inference runs on deployment hardware
Qwen3-8B.source: models_registry.json: 'Originally self-hosted; point api_base at any OpenAI-compatible server'
